_what: Brief 5 V3 -- spruce_half_01 octahedral imposter tiling, root-cause hypotheses. READ-ONLY (imposter_defect_read.json + T2). Orbit stills not captured; demo map NOT opened (level swap avoided).

asset.mesh: spruce_half_01 LOD4 (6 tris, the imposter card)
asset._frame_count_note: the octahedral frame grid (Frames/Rows) is baked into MA_Imposter's graph, not exposed as a scalar param (confirmed T2 + V3). Estimated 16x16 -> 256 px/frame (UE octahedral default).

hypotheses.root_cause: Octahedral frame selection/blend fails under HISM instanced rendering -- the material samples one atlas cell without cross-frame blend, showing the raw square atlas tile.
for: the defect is literally SQUARE TILES = a single un-blended atlas cell (desk crop 3)
MA_Imposter is a custom octahedral master that needs per-object bounds + camera-relative direction; place_foliage places these as HISM instances, a different data path than a single actor
only ImposterRoundingOffset is exposed -- the view-direction/bounds inputs are internal and may read object bounds that are degenerate/shared for instances
against: it renders (not black), so SOME data flows
would expect ALL octahedral imposters in the project to tile, not just this one

hypotheses.root_cause: ImposterRoundingOffset / frame-count mismatch: OffsetX 0.375 vs OffsetY 1.0 is asymmetric; if the baked atlas grid disagrees with these, frame selection lands between cells and tiles.
against: these are the vendor MI defaults, presumably validated in the Showroom demo map

hypotheses.root_cause: Placement scale/bounds mismatch: place_foliage's scale_range on the imposter breaks the octahedral direction math if the baked bounds do not track the placed scale.
for: foliage scale_range is applied per instance
against: would tile uniformly with scale, not as discrete square cells

C2_showroom_result.placement_in_demo: spruce_half_01 placed as FoliageInstancedStaticMeshComponent (HISM) AND StaticMeshComponent actors; 5 LODs; material slots [spruce_half_01_trunk, _branch, _leaf, half_01_imposter] -- the SAME half_01_imposter card material and the SAME HISM path as our foliage type.
C2_showroom_result.observation: At 150 m both AUTO and FORCED-CARD render clean, recognisable spruce billboards with NO square-tile artefact. The vendor's own demo shows the imposter working correctly under HISM.
C2_showroom_result.consequence: H1 DISCONFIRMED. The octahedral imposter does NOT fail under HISM instanced rendering -- the demo places it exactly as we do (HISM + half_01_imposter) and it renders clean. H2 (asset/offset) and H3 (scale) likewise not reproduced in the demo.

favoured: H4 CONFIRMED + RESOLVED -- scene-specific card magnification from the unpersisted hold, now fixed (R1 persist + R3 runtime). The imposter override MI is correct (vendor octahedral logic + wind/bending off); R4 disconfirms the override-defect hypothesis.
hypotheses_superseded: H1/H2/H3 above are retained for the record but are DISCONFIRMED or unreproduced by C2.
decisive_follow_up: View spruce_half_01 in ALPINE8K at 150 m forced-card (r.ForceLOD 8), viewmode lit -- the same conditions as c2_showroom_150_card. If it tiles there but not in the Showroom, the cause is the SCENE (lighting/exposure/streaming/card-magnification), not the asset. Pairs with fixing the hold: once the card is pushed past 512 m it is never drawn large, so the tiling disappears regardless of root cause.
note: The T3 hold was INTENDED to push this imposter past the 512 m cull so it is never drawn live -- but C1 proves the hold never persisted (false-success save; the live meshes carry the original card ScreenSize). So the tiling the desk flagged is STILL LIVE in the 128-512 m band. The fix is to RE-APPLY the hold and VERIFY it persists across an editor restart (out of this read-only session's scope).

R4_override_diff_result.verdict: DESK HYPOTHESIS (override starves the octahedral frame lookup) DISCONFIRMED. The _nowind override shares MA_Imposter and EVERY scalar/vector/texture parameter with the vendor MI; the ONLY difference is two static switches (Level 1 Bending, Level 1 Wind) turned OFF -- i.e. WPO wind/bending disabled, which does NOT touch octahedral frame selection (ImposterRoundingOffset/ZRot/Scale/Z/atlas textures all identical). The confirming swap experiment is MOOT (nothing to swap -- the frame logic is byte-identical to the vendor that renders clean in the Showroom).
R4_override_diff_result.consequence: H4 stands and is now RESOLVED by R1+R3: the tiling was the card drawn LARGE/CLOSE in 128-512 m because the T3 hold never persisted. R1 persisted the hold; R3 proved it took at runtime (+1.13 ms geometry-pass control), pushing the card past the 512 m cull so it is never drawn large. The imposter material is NOT defective.
